title.underReview: Your WhatsApp Account is Under Review

dialog.title: Message Failed to Send
dialog.needHelp: Need help? Contact admin for further assistance in resolving this issue.

131031.title: Account Locked
131031.description: Your WhatsApp Business Account has been restricted due to policy violations or verification data mismatch.
recovery: Check for any notifications or warnings on the dashboard
If there's a 'Request Review' option, submit an appeal

368.title: Temporarily Blocked
368.description: Account is temporarily blocked due to WhatsApp policy violations.
recovery: Review WhatsApp Business policies at business.whatsapp.com/policy
Wait until the block period ends
Contact admin if you need assistance

131048.title: Spam Rate Limit Hit
131048.description: Too many previous messages were blocked or reported as spam by recipients.
recovery: Ensure recipients have opted-in to receive messages
Improve message content quality and relevance
Check quality rating in WhatsApp Manager

131049.title: Delivery Blocked
131049.description: Meta chose not to deliver this message to maintain a healthy ecosystem.
recovery: Wait at least 24 hours before resending
Reduce marketing message frequency to the same user
Ensure content is relevant to the recipient

unknown.title: Unknown Error
unknown.description: An unknown error occurred while sending the message.
recovery: Contact admin if the issue persists
